name: Art Wallpapers
description: Another boring piece. Daily. Hand-picked fine-art wallpapers from anotherboring.day.

descriptions.en: Another boring piece. Daily. Browse hand-picked fine-art wallpapers, set or download them, and keep a local history.
descriptions.zh-CN: Another boring piece. Daily. 浏览每日精选艺术作品，设置或下载壁纸，并保留本地操作历史。

author: yevgen_glukhov

preferences.label: Apply Wallpaper To
preferences.description: On macOS, choose every desktop or only the current desktop.

descriptions.en: On macOS, choose every desktop or only the current desktop.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在 macOS 上选择应用到所有桌面或仅当前桌面。

preferences.label: Automatic Rotation
preferences.description: Allow the background command to rotate art wallpapers.

descriptions.en: Allow the background command to rotate art wallpapers. Off by default.
descriptions.zh-CN: 允许后台命令自动轮换艺术壁纸；默认关闭。

preferences.label: Rotation Interval
preferences.description: How often an enabled background rotation may change the wallpaper.

descriptions.en: How often an enabled background rotation may change the wallpaper.
descriptions.zh-CN: 启用自动轮换后，允许后台更换壁纸的时间间隔。

preferences.label: Rotation Notification
preferences.description: Show a notification after an automatic wallpaper change.

descriptions.en: Show a notification after an automatic wallpaper change.
descriptions.zh-CN: 自动更换壁纸后显示通知。

cacheTargets.label: Art wallpaper catalog
cacheTargets.description: Rebuildable anotherboring.day catalog and bounded image-slot index.

commands.name: set-random-art-wallpaper
commands.title: Set Random Art Wallpaper
commands.description: Set a random hand-picked artwork as wallpaper now.

descriptions.en: Set a random hand-picked artwork as wallpaper now.
descriptions.zh-CN: 立即将一幅随机精选艺术作品设为壁纸。

commands.name: auto-switch-art-wallpaper
commands.title: Rotate Art Wallpaper
commands.description: Run one rotation now; the same command powers opt-in background rotation.

descriptions.en: Run one rotation now; the same command powers opt-in background rotation.
descriptions.zh-CN: 立即轮换一次；同一命令也用于用户主动启用的后台轮换。
